latest_release.name: v3.9.0
latest_release.body:
## For self-hosters

What changed for Docker installs since the summer:

- Rela, the built-in AI assistant, runs on your own models. Point it at Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, LM Studio, LocalAI), or add Anthropic and OpenAI keys. Pick a model with strong tool calling, such as the qwen3 or llama3.1:70b class.
- Self-hosted installs are no longer metered. Until v3.8.0 a self-hosted workspace ran on the Cloud Free plan's limits. Now every configured model is available, and you set the send limit with CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.
- Gmail and Outlook mailbox and calendar sync, with your own Google OAuth client or Entra app. Turn it on with RELATICLE_FEATURE_EMAIL_INTEGRATION=true.
- Passkey sign-in.
- An MCP server at /mcp and a REST API that accepts OAuth tokens, so Claude Code, Cursor or your own scripts can read and update the CRM on your server.
- Task checklists: type [ ] in a task description, and board cards show progress.
- Deploy guides for Docker Compose, Coolify and Dokploy.

Self-hosting guide: https://relaticle.com/developers/self-hosting

detail.readme:
The Open-Source AI CRM for Selling Without a Sales Team

Website · Documentation · MCP Server · Roadmap · Discord


Clean, modern interface built with Filament 5 and Livewire 4

--- # About Relaticle Relaticle is a self-hosted CRM your AI agents can work in. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or an open-source model over MCP to read, write, and analyze your CRM data. Custom fields, REST API, and multi-workspace isolation. **Built for:** people who sell to a named list of companies without a sales team. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent to work in the CRM. **Core Strengths:** - **Agent-Native Infrastructure** - MCP server and REST API with full CRUD, schema access, activity history, and pipeline analysis - **Customizable Data Model** - Custom fields for text, dates, currency, selects, and links between records, with per-field encryption. No migrations needed. - **Multi-Workspace Isolation** - Workspace-scoped data with role-based permissions - **Modern Tech Stack** - Laravel 13, Filament 5, PHP 8.5, with an automated test suite on every change - **Privacy-First** - Self-hosted, AGPL-3.0, your data stays on your server # Connect an agent Relaticle ships an MCP server, so the agents you already use can work in your CRM. - **Claude**: add a connector with the URL `https://mcp.relaticle.com` (hosted) or `https://your-host/mcp` (self-hosted). - **ChatGPT**: install Relaticle from the [plugin directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a92c3af04a0819180ed6652ebe09961). - **Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI**: plugins and the extension live in [relaticle/agent-plugins](https://github.com/relaticle/agent-plugins). - **Anything else that speaks MCP**: Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 or a personal access token, one workspace per connection. Setup in the [MCP guide](https://relaticle.com/developers/mcp). # Run with Docker The fastest way to self-host. Six containers: the app, a queue worker, a scheduler, a websocket server, PostgreSQL, and Redis. 1. Download the compose file: ```bash curl -o compose.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Relaticle/relaticle/main/compose.yml ``` 2. Generate an application key: ```bash echo "APP_KEY=base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" ``` 3. Create a `.env` file with your settings: ```bash APP_KEY=base64:your-generated-key-here DB_PASSWORD=your-secure-database-password APP_URL=https://crm.example.com ``` 4. Start the containers: ```bash docker compose up -d ``` 5. Create your admin account: ```bash docker compose exec app php artisan make:filament-user ``` Your CRM is now available at `{APP_URL}/app`. The [Self-Hosting Guide](https://relaticle.com/docs/self-hosting) covers configuration, updates, backups, and a manual deployment. The sections below are for running from source. # Requirements - PHP 8.5+ - PostgreSQL 17+ - Composer 2 and Node.js 22+ - Redis for queues (optional for development) # Installation ```bash git clone https://github.com/Relaticle/relaticle.git cd relaticle && composer app-install ``` # Development ```bash # Start everything (server, queue, vite) composer dev # Run tests composer test # Format code composer lint ``` # Self-Hosting See the [Self-Hosting Guide](https://relaticle.com/docs/self-hosting) for Docker and manual deployment instructions. # Internationalization Relaticle ships English-only in the main repository, but the codebase is fully i18n-ready. Self-host forks can drop a `lang//` directory in place to translate the entire app. See [`docs/i18n.md`](docs/i18n.md) for the override workflow and CI guardrails. # Documentation Visit our [documentation](https://relaticle.com/docs) for guides on business usage, technical architecture, MCP server setup, REST API integration, and more. # Community & Support - [Report Issues](https://github.com/Relaticle/relaticle/issues) - [Request Features](https://relaticle.com/discord) - [Ask Questions](https://relaticle.com/discord) - [Star us on GitHub](https://github.com/Relaticle/relaticle) to support the project # License Relaticle is open-source software licensed under the [AGPL-3.0 license](LICENSE). The one exception is [`packages/Cloud`](packages/Cloud), the code behind relaticle.com, which [its own license](packages/Cloud/LICENSE) governs. Everything else stays AGPL-3.0. - Software that talks to Relaticle only through its REST API or MCP server can use any license, including a proprietary one. See the [Integration Exception](INTEGRATION-EXCEPTION.md). - The Relaticle name and logo are trademarks of Relaticle, Inc. If you host Relaticle for others or ship a modified version, use your own name. See the [Trademark Policy](.github/TRADEMARK.md). - Contributors sign a [Contributor License Agreement](.github/CLA.md) on their first pull request. # Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=relaticle/relaticle&type=date&legend=top-left&sealed_token=c38GyCHd6M75Bak3QvcMoEfYHGDlV1lAIyuGyJoQ8AA1kyVwXhZR7A1qYLuGDZg9H0LsvERRX3YUEkOWkjt4q0N0y-mlHVm2NI3mDb74NKAka4KPxMrBBA)](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=relaticle%2Frelaticle&type=date&legend=top-left)
